notes.title: Update 1.2 - New Animations, Stamina Bottle Mechanic, New tutorial and more!
notes.content:
[b]This is a huge update for us we will keep improving the game and making it the best experience we can! [/b]

[list]
 [*]New ancient bottle system, that allows the player to extended the stamina bar by finding this secret items (They work like the life fruits).

 [*]Special tutorial added to the start of the game to help the player direction to the seven legendary swords, with a better explanation of the Orin Insight.

 [*]Orin Insight was tottaly redone with new particle effects and new visual representation.

 [*]Every combat style has been reworked. The animation, damage and speed have changed to feel and play better.

 [*]Cloud Water and Niro (Final Boss) have now a more balanced damage and better AI that allows the player to attack them more easily.

 [*]Control Schemes added to options menu.

 [*]Buff stats that indicate what a kuro does like: HEALTH + or  SPEED ++.

 [*]When a tutorial is triggered now it will stop time so you can read it.

 [*]Trees that keep life fruits now have a mark with "X" close to them.

 [*]When you attack a small brightness will appear at the tip of your sword that means you can do a follow up attack.

 [*]Sword durability adjusted.

 [*]Less enemies on the map.

 [*]Small fixes to the collision and to the overall performace.
[/list]

    [*]Fixed minor performance improvements
